key_insight: TabFM-Auto couples a frozen tabular foundation model with a language-model agent that iteratively improves the surrounding data pipeline, rather than retraining the model itself.
engineering_relevance: This turns tabular ML into a reusable, search-based pipeline optimization problem that can boost zero-shot performance and transfer improvements across multiple foundation models.
method: Use dataset metadata, auxiliary files, and validation feedback to guide pipeline evolution.
Iteratively refine cleaning, feature engineering, context selection, and post-processing around TabFM.
Evaluate candidate pipelines and keep modifications that reduce validation error.
evidence_signal: Across all 51 TabArena datasets, the best configuration improved TabFM from 1785 to 2013 Elo, and the discovered pipelines transferred to other frozen tabular foundation models by +69 to +143 Elo.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of metadata and validation feedback, so noisy evaluations or dataset-specific leakage risks could mislead the search process.
paper_title: TabFM-Auto: Self-Evolving Pipelines for Tabular Foundation Models
